verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of GitLab's issue boards, epics, or roadmap features that would let a developer organize work from high-level plans down to daily tasks; only a vague reference to 'planning' as part of the platform (gitlab-docs-19) exists, with no detail on boards or roadmap hierarchies. Missing for 10: evidence of issue/epic boards, roadmap views, milestone/label workflows, or any hands-on corroboration of project-planning features.
